meta_description: Surprises that can happen inside a dungeon: rule rooms, vaults, rival awakened, locked exits and more.
title: Dungeon events

blocks.text: When a dungeon is generated, there is a 30% chance of an event, and a 20% chance of a second one. A pity rule makes them more likely the longer you go without (+15% per dungeon, guaranteed after 5). Only events allowed at the rank of the dungeon can happen, and at most one major event per dungeon.

blocks.text: A party holds up to 4 awakened. The XP of a kill is not split : every member who counts gets his full solo XP for it, as if he had hit the monster, multiplied by a party bonus (×1 alone, ×1.1 for two, ×1.2 for three, ×1.3 for four). A member counts when he is within 150 studs of the monster or in the same dungeon, alive or dead for less than 10 s; the kill also counts for his daily orders.

blocks.html:
TermMeaning
AwakenedA player: a human whose mana awoke. The game calls players awakened (no longer hunters).
HumanThe unawakened state (class None): no class, +8% all stats, +10% XP, the whole General tree open.
RankAn awakened's rank, E to S, then S+ (level 175) and Nation (level 250 + the System's trial), measured at the Awakened Registry.
Re-evaluationThe Registry's mana measurement: free, once a minute, gives the highest rank whose requirements are met.
RiftA gate opening in the city that leads to a procedural dungeon of its rank.
Red rift / anomalyA rare blood-red rift: monsters and loot one rank above, x1.5 XP and shards, a longer dungeon.
Rift breakA rift left until its timer runs out may break: monsters invade its district in waves.
GuardianThe boss at the end of a dungeon; the dungeon's theme decides which one.
Guardian spoilsThe reel after a guardian: one prize per awakened (equipment, shards, a boost or a rare item).
ShardsThe game's currency.
GradeAn item's rank letter, from its rarity: F (Trash), E, D, C, B, A, S (Mythic); EX (Limited editions) and SP (exclusive rewards) above.
S+ / Nation editionGear of the ranks above S, found from rank S+ / Nation; Nation weapons only from a guardian's rare roll.
ForgeUpgrades an item (+1 .. +10, +25, +30), climbs its grade, or rerolls its bonuses.
Special classA hidden class (Spellblade, Survivor, Warper, Bipolar, Berserker, Reaper, Chad, Overlord) unlocked by a secret feat; level cap 999.
System ArtsThe battle pass's skill tree: skills unlocked by pass levels, for every class.
Weapon artThe weapon's own skill, on key E.
GemstoneA cosmetic box: 9 cosmetics, one of them secret.
Double dungeonA dungeon event: beyond the guardian, a second dungeon one rank above.
PantheonThe board of the fastest System's trial times (rank Nation).
LuckThe multiplier on drop chances and on the spoils' higher grades; every bonus adds up, x6 at most.
RuneA stone dropped by dungeon guardians (12 kinds, Common to Mythic), engraved into a weapon, armor or pendant at the Rune Temple for a small bonus while the item is worn.
StarA mark added to a weapon or an armor at the forge with essences: each star gives the item +4% of its own stats inside dungeons, 5 at most.
EssenceWhat stars cost: every dungeon boss gives some to the awakened who helped defeat it, more for a higher rank.
Transit kioskOne of the 25 kiosks of the city's transit network: pick a stop and travel there at once, for free (not during a fight).

blocks.text: Gear has a grade , written as a rank letter, rolled when it drops: F Trash, E Common, D Uncommon, C Rare, B Epic, A Legendary, S Mythic. Above them: EX (Limited editions, never in the shops) and SP (exclusive rewards between S and EX). An account can own several copies of an EX or SP item; only the profile that earned a copy can trade, sell or auction it. A better grade multiplies the stats and the value of the item.

blocks.text: The forge is in the Awakened Plaza. It does three things, and none of them can destroy your item :

blocks.text: Upgrade (+1, +2...) : each level adds 8% to the main stats. Max +10 , +25 for an S-grade weapon, +30 for EX and SP weapons. It never fails. Grade climb (at +10): the item goes up one grade (up to S), its forge level goes back to +0 and it gains new bonuses. Reforge : rerolls the bonus stats of the item ( reforge table ). It is the only random part.

  • Reforge: rerolls the bonus stats of the item (reforge table). It is the only random part.

blocks.text: Costs: Item and forge formulas .

blocks.text: The market sells potions and gear of your rank . Its stock changes every hour and is the same for every awakened of your rank: each model is mostly Uncommon (D), sometimes Common, Rare or Epic, rarely Legendary. Models of a higher rank, the Nation weapons and the exclusive editions are never sold. Buying costs 4 times the rank E value of the item, times a factor of your rank (from ×1 at rank E to ×30 at Nation, ×130 for a weapon); selling gives back 80% of what you paid (or of its value for a looted item), plus 80% of the shards you put into it at the forge. See Economy formulas and the market stock table .

subtitle: Overrank is a Roblox action RPG where you rise from a nobody to an S-rank awakened by clearing rifts, forging gear and beating guardians.

blocks.text: Overrank is an action RPG on Roblox, made by the AwaitLab studio. You are an awakened : a human whose mana woke up. Gates called rifts open in your city; you walk into one, fight through its rooms with your class and its skills, defeat the guardian at the end and collect shards , XP and gear.
blocks.html: Overrank is an action RPG on Roblox, made by the AwaitLab studio. You are an awakened: a human whose mana woke up. Gates called rifts open in your city; you walk into one, fight through its rooms with your class and its skills, defeat the guardian at the end and collect shards, XP and gear.

blocks.text: 15 classes : 7 you can pick freely and 8 special ones you have to earn (see Classes ). Rank E to S, S+ and Nation : your rank measures how strong you really are (see Progression path ). Gear that you forge : weapons, armor and accessories, with a forge that never destroys your item. Rifts of every rank , red anomaly rifts, rift breaks, double dungeons, guild raids and a seasonal event. PvP in the Colosseum and an Endless Tower for solo players. Guilds , a battle pass each season, daily rewards and codes.
blocks.html:
• 15 classes: 7 you can pick freely and 8 special ones you have to earn (see Classes).
  • Rank E to S, S+ and Nation: your rank measures how strong you really are (see Progression path).
  • Gear that you forge: weapons, armor and accessories, with a forge that never destroys your item.
  • Rifts of every rank, red anomaly rifts, rift breaks, double dungeons, guild raids and a seasonal event.
  • PvP in the Colosseum and an Endless Tower for solo players.
  • Guilds, a battle pass each season, daily rewards and codes.

blocks.html:
• Shield: at 66% and 33% of its health it is shielded for 3 s and 4 monsters drop out of the gate (more with more awakened, 10 at most; none when it is on every server)
  • Health: set by the strength of the awakened who fight it, for a fight of about 7 minutes; it grows when more awakened come or when it falls too fast (what was taken stays taken), it shrinks a little when the fight drags
  • Time limit: 15 minutes from the start of the invasion; still standing then, the gate closes and nobody is rewarded

blocks.text: Once it falls, every awakened on the damage board (any damage counts) is rewarded by his place: shards (the clear shards of the rank's dungeon ×8, plus up to ×20 more for his share of the damage; places 1 to 3 ×2, ×1.6 and ×1.3), an item of the rank's grade (one grade higher for the first place), a 20-minute ×2 XP and shards boost, an XP token and a shard token. Places 1 to 3 also get an anomaly summon and 2 luck tokens.

title: Monsters, guardians and bosses
subtitle: 78 monsters: regular monsters, the guardians that close each dungeon and a few bosses.

blocks.text: Normal : the monsters of the rooms. Elite : any normal monster can roll elite (bigger, ×2 XP, drops shards and sometimes an item). Guardian : the final fight of a dungeon; the dungeon theme decides which one. Boss : special fights (training, events).
blocks.html:
• Normal: the monsters of the rooms.
  • Elite: any normal monster can roll elite (bigger, ×2 XP, drops shards and sometimes an item).
  • Guardian: the final fight of a dungeon; the dungeon theme decides which one.
  • Boss: special fights (training, events).

blocks.text: The numbers on a monster page are its own base stats. In a rift they are multiplied by the rank of the rift (×1 at rank E up to ×21 HP at Nation, guardians up to ×55): see Dungeon formulas . The game has no elemental weaknesses or resistances.
blocks.html: The numbers on a monster page are its own base stats. In a rift they are multiplied by the rank of the rift (×1 at rank E up to ×21 HP at Nation, guardians up to ×55): see Dungeon formulas. The game has no elemental weaknesses or resistances.

blocks.text: A guardian has more phases the higher the rift rank (2 at rank E, up to 6 at Nation). It starts attacking faster after each one. Variants are rolled at the start of the dungeon: Standard, Enraged (faster below 50% HP) and Summoner (calls adds at 66% and 33%).

sections.heading: Pity, modifiers and how to read

blocks.text: Luck bonuses are added, not multiplied: multiplier = 1 + the sum of the bonuses, x6 at most. It multiplies the chance of the lines marked with a sparkle, 100% at most. In a guardian's spoils only the grades above the centre rank get the luck (x3 at most, with the dungeon stars bonus), then the table is scaled back to 100%. "At least 1 in N tries" = 1 - (1 - p)^N: the chance to get it at least once. "1 in N" is an average: you can get it sooner or much later.
blocks.html:
• Luck bonuses are added, not multiplied: multiplier = 1 + the sum of the bonuses, x6 at most. It multiplies the chance of the lines marked with a sparkle, 100% at most.
  • In a guardian's spoils only the grades above the centre rank get the luck (x3 at most, with the dungeon stars bonus), then the table is scaled back to 100%.
  • "At least 1 in N tries" = 1 - (1 - p)^N: the chance to get it at least once.
  • "1 in N" is an average: you can get it sooner or much later.

Day 12 min, night 8 min.

meta_description: 136 skills: the skill tree of every class, the General tree and the System Arts of the battle pass.
title: Skills: trees and System Arts
subtitle: 136 skills: the skill tree of every class, the General tree and the System Arts of the battle pass.

blocks.text: Each level gives 1 skill point . You spend points in the skill tree of your class (or the General tree as a Human) to unlock active skills and passives . A skill needs the previous one of its chain at maximum level. Each skill level past the first adds +15% power and −5% cooldown .
blocks.html: Each level gives 1 skill point. You spend points in the skill tree of your class (or the General tree as a Human) to unlock active skills and passives. A skill needs the previous one of its chain at maximum level. Each skill level past the first adds +15% power and −5% cooldown.

blocks.text: Class trees : about 12 skills per class, in 5 tiers (a tier costs as many points per level as its number). Mage schools : the Mage has several schools of magic (fire, ice, lightning, arcane, water, earth, void...). Some of them stay hidden until you place enough school points. General tree : open to every class; full for the Human. System Arts : skills of the battle pass , for every class, no skill points needed. Weapon arts : the skill of a weapon, on key E: see Weapon arts .
blocks.html:
• Class trees: about 12 skills per class, in 5 tiers (a tier costs as many points per level as its number).
  • Mage schools: the Mage has several schools of magic (fire, ice, lightning, arcane, water, earth, void...). Some of them stay hidden until you place enough school points.
  • General tree: open to every class; full for the Human.
  • System Arts: skills of the battle pass, for every class, no skill points needed.
  • Weapon arts: the skill of a weapon, on key E: see Weapon arts.

blocks.text: Each page lists the element, cooldown, mana cost, damage (a percentage of your physical or magic power) and how to unlock it. Cooldowns are base values: see Combat formulas .

meta_description: What happens when you fall: in the city, in a dungeon (extra lives, elimination, the comeback for Robux) and in the Endless Tower.
title: Falling: lives and revives
subtitle: What happens when you fall: in the city, in a dungeon (extra lives, elimination, the comeback for Robux) and in the Endless Tower.

blocks.text: You get up after 3 s , untouchable for 2 s.
blocks.html: You get up after 3 s, untouchable for 2 s.

blocks.text: On entering you get extra lives , rolled between 0 and a maximum that depends on the rift's rank (more in the low ranks). Fallen with a life left, you come back in the furthest room the party cleared (the entrance before that). Out of lives: ELIMINATED . You have 45 s to choose: watch the hunters still standing, leave, or come back for 39 R$ (once per dungeon). No choice: you leave. Once out, there is no way back into that same dungeon. A rift that collapses crushes everyone inside: back to the city. Not hurt once since you entered? You earn +5% XP in the dungeon while it lasts (the no-hit bonus).

meta_description: Up to 4 awakened playing together on any server: invitations, the leader, rifts as a party, the shared XP and the tougher dungeons.
title: Party
subtitle: Up to 4 awakened playing together on any server: invitations, the leader, rifts as a party, the shared XP and the tougher dungeons.

blocks.text: Open the party window with L (gamepad: Menu > Social). A party holds up to 4 awakened. The leader, or anyone not in a party yet, can invite; the party is made when the invitation is accepted. An invitation lasts 30 s ; 12 s must pass before inviting the same awakened again. A party works across servers : you can join a member where he is, on another server or in his rift. The leader can kick, promote another member or disband the party. If he leaves, the oldest member leads; a party left with one member is dissolved. Quitting the game leaves the party at once. A teleport (a rift, a travel) keeps you in it; a member seen nowhere for 2 minutes is removed.

blocks.text: The XP of a kill is not split : every member within 150 studs of the monster or in the same dungeon (alive, or fallen less than 10 s ago) gets his full solo XP, ×1.1 for two, ×1.2 for three, ×1.3 for four. A monster 3 or more ranks above you that you did not hit yourself gives only ×0.25. Details: Leveling formulas .

blocks.text: Runes drop only from dungeon guardians : each awakened there rolls (12% in a rank E dungeon up to 35% in a Nation one, x1.5 in a guild raid); a higher rank's dungeon gives rarer runes. Odds: rune drops and rune rarity . At the altar of the Rune Temple , engrave a rune into a weapon, armor or pendant that it fits. One rune per item: a new one replaces the old one (lost). The item is then bound for a while: it cannot be worn, sold, traded or forged. Once free, the rune works while the item is worn. Skip the binding with shards (per hour left) or Robux, or with a binding skip bought from the traveling merchant .

meta_description: Swap items and shards with another awakened: how to ask, what can never be traded, and when a trade is called off.
title: Trading
subtitle: Swap items and shards with another awakened: how to ask, what can never be traded, and when a trade is called off.

blocks.text: Walk up to an awakened and press T (Trade). He has 30 s to accept; two awakened asking each other at the same time open the trade at once. Both must be level 3 or more. Wait 4 s between two requests. Each side offers up to 8 things (items of the bag, tradeable cosmetics) and up to 10,000,000 shards . Any change puts both sides back to not ready . When both are ready, a 3 s countdown runs, everything is checked again, then the swap is made and both profiles are saved at the same moment.

meta_description: 25 transit kiosks link the services, places and quarters of the city: free, instant, open from the start.
title: Transit network
subtitle: 25 transit kiosks link the services, places and quarters of the city: free, instant, open from the start.

blocks.text: Walk to a transit kiosk and hold its prompt: the network's window opens, with a live view of the city and the open rifts. Pick a stop (or search a place), then TRAVEL : you are there at once, with no loading screen. It is free . Not during a fight: wait a few seconds after a hit. Stay by the kiosk while you choose; the network recharges for a moment between two trips. Mark up to 12 stops as favourites ; the nearest kiosk is always shown in the city with its distance. Keyboard: click a stop, ↑ ↓ to browse, Enter to travel, Esc to close. Gamepad: D-pad, A to travel, Y for a favourite, B to close.
